concept: DynamoDB global tables: multi-Region active-active replication
tests: How to keep DynamoDB reads/writes working through a full Region outage with low latency for users in different Regions.
expected: DynamoDB global tables — multi-Region active-active replication, local reads and writes. Triggers: "entire Region becomes unavailable", "reads and writes", "low-latency from multiple Regions".
why_not: DAX — cache within a single Region; on-demand capacity — scales throughput but single Region; Streams + Lambda backup — not active-active.
